Sources & licenses

IEX historical observations

Data provided for free by IEX. By accessing or using IEX Historical Data, you agree to the IEX Historical Data Terms of Use.

IEX retains rights in its data. These observations represent activity on IEX only, not consolidated U.S. markets or NBBO. They are historical reference data, not a basis for live trading decisions. The game is independent and is not sponsored or endorsed by IEX.

Sources: December 24, 2018; March 16, 2020; and June 11, 2020 TOPS 1.6 captures, using documented IEX Transport Protocol 1. The first eligible two-sided regular-session quote at least one second after the preceding retained observation is kept. Availability is transport send time rounded upward to milliseconds. Original event timestamps and sequence identifiers are retained. Paused, halted, extended-session, one-sided and unavailable quotes are not executable. Prices are never interpolated.

Candles aggregate observed bid quotes. They are not trade OHLC. Quote sizes are not trade volume, and this release does not reconstruct a consolidated order book or exchange queue. Fictional orders fill against subsequent retained quotes with a shared ten-share cap. This assumption is not a promise of historical execution.

Separate daily reference challenges

Daily challenges use historical reference or closing values, with fictional next-observation settlement. A calendar date is not a reconstructed publication timestamp. No intervening quotes, bid/ask, trading volume or minute candles are generated.

European Central Bank

Selected daily reference rates are reproduced under the ECB copyright policy. Source: European Central Bank. EUR/CHF is directly scaled; GBP/EUR is the reciprocal of the source GBP-per-EUR reference, rounded to six decimals. These are disclosed modifications. Reference rates are informational, not executable transaction prices. No ECB logo or endorsement.

USDA AMS cotton

Source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, Cotton and Tobacco Program, Annual Cotton Price Statistics2010–2011 Table3. Selected USDA-owned spot quotations under the AMS reuse policy. Original cents/netlb divided by100 intoUSD/netlb. ICE futures and third-party Cotlook content are excluded. This is a virtual cash-inventory challenge; delivery, storage and grading are omitted.

Shanghai Stock Exchange daily information

Source: Shanghai Stock Exchange600519 daily closing statistics. The current CIIS market-data policy,page11, exempts end-of-day redistribution after midnight. This does not license an intraday feed, other Chinese exchanges or another supplier's data. Only historicalEOD information is selected. The game models100-share order lots and a one-observation resale lag; it omits commissions, stamp duty, auction queues and guaranteed price-limit liquidity.

Practice limitations

Accounts, order capacity, mission conditions and execution are fictional. No real orders are transmitted. Replays use known history and do not demonstrate investment skill, blind testing, actual profits or real-world adoption. Trading halts and unavailable observations can create genuine waiting periods.

AEMO electricity clearing prices

Australian Energy Market Operator: public DISPATCHPRICE NSW1 RRP, June 2022. All 37 five-minute interval-ending values in the declared 12 June 17:00–20:00 AEST window are retained, including ten APC flag 16 loss-factor adjustments. Original price decimals, source keys, flags and source archive hashes are carried in the chapter/report. AEMO grants attributed use of its public material; the data is not MIT-licensed. No AEMO endorsement. Finalized settlement history is not an executable bid/ask stream; simulated cash-settled MWh exposure is not physical electricity inventory or futures.

Georgios Fatouros (INNOV ACTS LTD) and Konstantina Tripodi (JRC Capital Management Consultancy & Research GmbH), High frequency (tick data) of historical FOREX prices, version 1.0.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7411148, published under CC BY 4.0. See full attribution and modification notice. The selected 714 EURUSD price ticks and 238 preceding context records retain original prices and source ordinals. Integer encoding, selected window, fictional accounts and execution are modifications. No author endorsement.

Permission is the publisher's CC grant for its numerical compilation; full underlying vendor-rights certification is not claimed. The source clock is not labelled UTC. No spread, volume, missing ticks or executable broker quotes are invented.

This is the publisher's numerical-compilation grant; no direct exchange/vendor clearance or independent exchange-feed authentication is claimed. Displayed depth is never assumed executable. One regular-morning funded account models 100-share lots and locks new purchases for the rest of the chapter; next-day release, auctions, price-limit queues, actual commissions and stamp duty are omitted. This ordinary morning is not a claimed black-swan event. No publisher or exchange endorsement.
